title: Ashbury Rewards Member Tenure Recognition: Tenure Waiver on Stay Credit Reversals
content:
| Whole calendar months enrolled in Ashbury Rewards by the handling date | Tenure waiver on a stay credit reversal |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 1000 points |
| 36 to 119 | 500 points |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

**Schedule note.** A member enrolled for at least one hundred and twenty whole calendar months by the handling date has a tenure waiver of one thousand points, a member enrolled for thirty-six to one hundred and nineteen whole months has a tenure waiver of five hundred points, and a member enrolled for fewer months has none. The waiver is taken off the points to be reversed when a folio correction takes back points earned on a stay, and never takes them below zero. The months are whole calendar months from the enrolment date on the membership to the handling date.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date of 10 September 2026).**

| Enrolment date | Whole months | Tenure waiver |
|---|---|---|
| 11 September 2023 | 35 | None |
| 10 September 2023 | 36 | 500 points |
| 11 September 2016 | 119 | 500 points |
| 10 September 2016 | 120 | 1000 points |

A reversal of 800 points for a member with a 1000-point tenure waiver leaves nothing to reverse: the points reversed are zero.
